findings: V1 (LOW/MODERATE, FIXED): rulesetRequires counted a ruleset that merely LISTED the check regardless of enforcement/target, so a consumer could commit a DISABLED (or wrong-branch) ruleset, run apply-ruleset.sh (succeeds), commit the marker, and false-clear the nudge while nothing is enforced - reachable via the tool happy path, the exact false-negative the nudge exists to prevent. FIXED: rulesetRequires now requires enforcement==active AND a default-branch target (~DEFAULT_BRANCH/~ALL/refs/heads/main|master), erring toward nudging when it cannot confirm. Added disabled + wrong-branch + literal-main discrimination tests; verified end-to-end (disabled/wrong-branch keep nudging, active default-branch clears).
grepCommands: node --test enforcement-nudge + emit-directive-nudge + always-on-emit -> 34 pass 0 fail incl new disabled/wrong-branch guards (observed)
e2e real emitter on a consumer: disabled+marker->NUDGE, wrong-branch+marker->NUDGE, active-default+marker->cleared; origin (no workflow)->silent; subagent->silent (observed)
origin has no .github/workflows/enterprise-gates.yml so the nudge never fires here; arch gate PASS; full suite 648 pass 0 fail 2 skip(bash-flake) (observed)
verdict: PASS after fix. Review found 1 (LOW/MODERATE): an inert-ruleset false-clear (disabled or wrong-branch ruleset silenced the nudge via the happy path) - FIXED by requiring enforcement==active + default-branch target, erring toward nudging, with discrimination tests. Everything else clean: origin-safe (keys on the workflow file), best-effort (never breaks the directive), apply-ruleset cannot write a lying marker, genesis scaffold is no-clobber + rollback-tracked, ADR ceiling matches code.
